visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a yellow character with a big head (Shaogao) excitedly lifting a blue box labeled 'HOME GRILL' over his head against a pale yellow background. (2) A pink-haired girl character (Hanhang) appears with stars in her eyes, imagining a grilled squid on a stick inside a thought bubble. (3) Both characters are on a yellow sofa; Hanhang licks her lips while Shaogao looks determined next to the grill box on a wooden table. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor fish market stall where a brown character with a white headband sells fish. Shaogao walks up with a striped shopping bag and points to a squid. (5) Back at home, Shaogao lifts the bag triumphantly; Hanhang's eyes turn into sparkling stars in a close-up shot. (6) A purple squid is placed on a brown cutting board; the background is blue. Shaogao holds a sharp kitchen knife with a glint, looking hungry and licking his lips. (7) The squid in a close-up looks terrified with large, teary eyes and starts shaking and crying. Shaogao's expression changes to one of concern and hesitation as he waves his hand. (8) The knife is dropped, and the next scene shows the squid happily swimming in a glass fishbowl on the table. Shaogao and Hanhang sit on the sofa behind the bowl, eating cup noodles with chopsticks. (9) A white screen appears featuring the squid surrounded by smaller fish, promoting a LINE sticker set with various emotional expressions and text overlays.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: HOME GRILL. (2) [Variety]: +1. (3) [Subtitle]: CUP NOODLE. (4) [Slogan]: 我是不是太多魚. LINE原創貼圖. (5) [Slogan]: 敏感的花枝黑噴. (6) [Variety]: 找我嗎? 讚! OK! 我先離開. 謝謝! 被撩到了. 需要建議. 眼睛進沙. 好像說錯話了. 比我重要嗎? 找我敏感. 你是不是討厭我? 不這在嫉妒. 哼. 嗯... 對不起. 他們是不是有私聊. 哀好喔. 我想多. 關我沒事. 我才沒有生器. 讓我靜一下. 已複原. +1. !?.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a minimalist indoor living room with a yellow sofa and wooden table. There is a brief scene at a simplified outdoor market stall with a blue awning.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with a bright, percussive acoustic guitar strum and a sharp 'ding' sound effect. Upbeat, bouncy acoustic music with a harmonica lead starts immediately. (2) A female voice shouts an energetic 'Yay!' followed by cartoonish popping sounds. (3) A 'Tada!' slide-whistle sound accompanies the reveal of the striped bag. (4) A sharp metallic 'shing' sound effect plays as the knife appears, followed by a dramatic silence. (5) High-pitched whimpering and sobbing noises begin, representing the squid's crying. (6) A percussive 'clunk' sound signifies the knife being set aside. (7) Loud slurping sound effects repeat as the characters eat noodles, while the upbeat folk BGM continues in a loop. (8) The music fades into a final jingle as the sticker promo appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Inciting Incident -> Conflict -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a narrative advertisement for a LINE sticker set. It creates an emotional connection with the 'Sensitive Squid' character by showing it as too cute and sympathetic to be eaten, leading the main characters to adopt it as a pet instead. The cute animation style and humorous outcome encourage viewers to purchase the sticker set.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A dedicated end screen promotes 'Sensitive Squid' (敏感的花枝黑噴) LINE stickers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic 'cute animal subversion' trope where the expectation of eating food is turned into keeping it as a pet.
